display.title: Display
display.themeHint: Affects the whole app immediately. Saved on your device.

backgroundMatch.title: Match notifications
backgroundMatch.intro: When this is on, we match new job ads against your profile every night. Top matches are emailed to you right away. Strong matches are collected into a summary you receive by email at the chosen rate. Good matches appear in your match list without email. You can turn this off at any time.
backgroundMatch.toggleLabel: Match new job ads for me
backgroundMatch.toggleDescription: Off by default. Turning it on means you consent to us matching new job ads against your profile and sending notifications by email.
backgroundMatch.cadenceLabel: How often to receive the summary
backgroundMatch.cadenceHint: Also applies to the notifications about companies you follow.
backgroundMatch.cadenceHintDisabled: Turn on match notifications, or notifications about companies you follow, to choose how often the email summary is sent.

followedCompanyNotifications.title: Notifications about companies you follow
followedCompanyNotifications.intro: New ads from companies you follow always appear in the app, whatever you choose here. On Overview you see how many are new. Here you choose whether we should also email them to you.
followedCompanyNotifications.toggleLabel: Email me new ads from companies I follow
followedCompanyNotifications.toggleDescription: Off by default. Turning it on means you consent to us emailing you new ads from the companies you follow. You can withdraw your consent at any time by turning this off.
followedCompanyNotifications.cadenceNote: The email follows the same rate as the match notifications: {cadence}. You change the rate in the Match notifications card.
followedCompanyNotifications.cadenceNoteDisabled: The email follows the same rate as the match notifications. You change the rate in the Match notifications card.
followedCompanyNotifications.filterNote: If you have set a filter on a company, it applies both in the app and to the emails. You change the filters under Companies.

danger.title: Delete your account
danger.description: You can delete your account and everything you have saved. For 30 days afterwards you can have it restored.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.description: Your account and everything you have saved are deleted, and you are logged out on all devices. For 30 days you can have the account restored by emailing kontakt@jobbliggaren.se. After that it is deleted for good and cannot be recovered.
delete.confirmEmailLabel: Enter your email address to confirm
delete.confirmMismatch: Enter your email address as it appears below the field.
delete.mailOff: Email delivery is not enabled right now, so we cannot send a code. If you want to delete your account, email <mail>kontakt@jobbliggaren.se</mail>.
delete.outcomeUnknown: We cannot tell whether the account was deleted. Reload the page.
delete.contactRoute: You can also email <mail>kontakt@jobbliggaren.se</mail> and ask us to delete the account.

reauth.request: To confirm that it is you, we send a six-digit code to {email}.
reauth.sent: We have sent a code to {email}. The code is valid for 15 minutes.
reauth.burned: You have entered the wrong code three times, so the code can no longer be used. Send a new code and try again.
reauth.resendReceipt: We have sent a new code. Enter the code from the most recent email.
reauth.cooldown: A code was requested for your account a moment ago. Wait a minute and try again.
reauth.budgetExhausted: Your account has reached the limit on how many codes can be sent per day. Wait a day and try again.
reauth.unavailable: A code cannot be sent right now. Try again in a few minutes.
reauth.verifyUnavailable: The code cannot be checked right now. Try again in a few minutes.
reauth.codeSpent: The code you entered has been used, so you will need a new code when you try again.
reauth.notLoggedIn: You are no longer logged in. Log in again and start over.

changeEmail.title: Change email address
changeEmail.description: You confirm the change with two codes, one to each address. Once the address has changed, you are logged out on all other devices.
changeEmail.invalidEmail: Enter the new email address in the correct format, for example name@example.com.
changeEmail.sameEmail: The new address is the same as your current one. Enter a different address.
changeEmail.codeStep: We have sent a six-digit code to {newEmail}. The code is valid for 15 minutes.
changeEmail.codeLabel: Code sent to the new address
changeEmail.wrongCode: The code is not correct. Use the code from the email to the new address and check the digits.
changeEmail.lastAttempt: One attempt left. After that you need to start over.
changeEmail.deadCode: That code can no longer be used. Start over to get new codes.
changeEmail.burned: You have entered the wrong code three times, so the code can no longer be used. Start over to get new codes.
changeEmail.success: The address has been changed, and you log in with {newEmail} from now on. You are logged out on all other devices.
changeEmail.unusable: The new email address cannot be used. Check it or enter a different one.
changeEmail.notDone: The change was not made, and your address is unchanged.
changeEmail.incomplete: The change could not be completed, and your address is unchanged. Wait a while.
changeEmail.outcomeUnknown: We cannot tell whether the address was changed. Reload the page.

errors.changeEmailCooldown: An email change cannot be requested right now. Try again later.
